introductionText.p1: I have been a physical therapist since 2012. After several years working with elite athletes in Berlin, then five years in orthopedics in Lyon, I became passionate about how the body recovers: after surgery, after pregnancy, or simply over the course of a busy life.
introductionText.p2: Today, I support you before and after cosmetic or reconstructive surgery, and after the birth of your baby until you return to sport. I also offer drainage: therapeutic when your health requires it, or wellness with the Renata França method.
introductionText.p3: My guiding principle: putting my expertise at the service of your goals, with attentive listening and treatments chosen for their effectiveness, in warm settings in Lyon 1 and Lyon 5.

objectivesText.title: MY GOAL: TO HELP YOU ACHIEVE YOURS
objectivesText.p1: Whether you are preparing for an operation, have just given birth or simply need to feel lighter, every treatment starts with time to listen: your history, how you feel, how tired you are, and the goal for the day.
objectivesText.p2: I then adapt each session to fit your needs of the moment as closely as possible, in coordination with your surgeon or doctor when necessary.

youMatterText.title: MAKE YOU THE CENTER OF THE WORLD, FOR A MOMENT
youMatterText.p1: Beyond personalized care, Lyvi is an experience in itself, centered around you.
youMatterText.p2: Everything has been designed to make you feel at home. I welcome you with a smile, in French, German or English, so that language is never a barrier.
youMatterText.p3: The space is meant to be warm, cozy, intimate and comforting, what Germans sum up in a single word: gemütlich.
youMatterText.p4: And because life as a new mother leaves little time, part of the postpartum follow-up can even be done online.

physioText.title: THE HIGH STANDARDS OF ELITE SPORT
physioText.p1: I have always been passionate about motorsport. My childhood dream was to work at Porsche. And in my little girl's mind, getting in there meant I had to speak German. So that's why I started learning it, on my own, at the age of 8. 😅
physioText.p2: Today, I don't (yet) work at Porsche, but speaking fluent German has opened other doors for me, including the one to elite sport.
physioText.p3: In particular, I was the physical therapist for the German men's artistic gymnastics national team in Berlin for several years, and I worked with athletes, some of whom went on to become world champions or Olympic silver medalists.
physioText.p4: Working in high-performance sport requires being effective no matter what, and working hand in hand with doctors. It is these high standards that I now bring to every treatment: precise technique, coordination with your surgeon, and advice to help you move again with confidence.

likeMeText.title: AN EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS WHO I AM
likeMeText.p1: Lyvi is ultimately a reflection of my identity: professional care provided in a relaxed atmosphere where simplicity is key.
likeMeText.p2BeforeLiv: The name Lyvi is inspired by the Scandinavian word
likeMeText.p2AfterLiv: , which means "life" — life as I see it: in motion, made up of encounters and projects, laughter and lightness, which I hope to communicate to you.
likeMeText.p3: Be yourself, it's the best way to feel comfortable and have a good time.
likeMeText.p4: I'm looking forward to welcoming you.
